name: e-Tourist/e-Business/e-Medical Visa and Business Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Pakistan-origin nationals and diplomatic/official passport holders are ineligible for the e-Visa; other nationalities apply online through the e-Visa portal.
Entry must be through one of 25 designated airports or 5 designated seaports (seaports for cruise tourists only).

Purpose must be a qualifying business activity: establishing a venture, buying/selling goods, technical meetings, staff recruitment, acting as a business partner/director, exhibitions, quality monitoring, or short-term specialist expertise -- not employment.
Must provide proof of financial standing and business documentation; sponsorship must originate from the applicant's country of origin or domicile (minimum 2 years' residence there).

evidence_required.document: Business documentation and proof of financial standing (Business Visa track)

outcome.duration_length: e-Visa: up to 60 days (medical: up to 6 months on extension), max 2 visits/calendar year, generally non-extendable except e-Medical. Business Visa (paper): up to 5 years multiple entry (up to 10 years for US citizens under a bilateral arrangement), max 6 months per visit, non-extendable beyond 5 years.

sources.title: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India -- Details of Visas Granted by India: e-Tourist, e-Business, e-Medical Visa sub-categories, each up to 60 days (medical extendable to 6 months case-by-case); application 120 days before arrival via 25 designated airports/5 seaports; max 2 visits/calendar year; non-extendable except e-Medical; Pakistan-origin nationals and diplomatic passport holders excluded

Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India -- FAQs Relating to Work Related Visas: Business (B) Visa eligibility (venture establishment, trading, technical meetings, recruitment, directorship, exhibitions, quality monitoring, short-term specialist expertise), no minimum salary, up to 5 years multiple entry (10 years for US citizens), max 6 months per visit, non-extendable beyond 5 years, sponsorship must originate from country of domicile with 2+ years' residence there plus proof of financial standing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (India). Published on tier-1 sourcing directly from the Ministry of Home Affairs. Two genuinely distinct products bundled here: the modern e-Visa (short-stay, online, capped at 60 days) and the older paper Business Visa (up to 5 years multiple entry, but strictly non-work). The e-Visa system explicitly and by name excludes Pakistan-origin nationals -- a rare explicit nationality carve-out stated directly by the government rather than inferred, reflecting the current state of India-Pakistan relations. No distinct short-stay tourist paper visa route was modeled separately since the e-Visa has functionally displaced it for most nationalities eligible for e-Visa; nationals who are e-Visa-ineligible (including Pakistan-origin nationals) apply through a different paper process not detailed in the sources retrieved in this build.
